```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

Code accompanying: Trachtenberg, E., Mousley, A., Jelen, M., & Astle, D. *Mapping social functioning profiles across childhood neurodevelopmental difficulties: links with diagnosis, cognition, and everyday executive function.*

Categorical profile membership captures only children with a clear expression of one profile, so it may obscure graded differences with age. We therefore examined age as a continuous predictor of profile expression, using generalised additive models (GAMs; R package mgcv) of the centroid-distance scores, with a cubic regression spline for age (k = 10), adjusted for sex and referral status. P values were corrected across the four profiles using the Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate. The same models were fitted to the four social dimension scores (supplement).

**Data availability.** No data are included in this repository; the code is shared to show the analysis. CALM data are available via the [CALM data portal](https://portal.camide.cam.ac.uk/overview/1158), subject to the cohort's data access procedures.

# Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(mgcv)
```

# Load data

One row per child: age, sex, referral status, the four social dimension scores (SOM input, 0-1) and the four centroid-distance scores (output of `02_SOM_social_profiles.ipynb`).

```{r}
dat <- read_csv("merged_data.csv") %>%
  rename(any_of(c(age_in_months       = "age_in_months_x",
                  sex                 = "sex_x",
                  referral            = "source",
                  prosocial           = "prosocial_org",
                  friendship          = "making_friends_org",
                  withdrawal          = "social_difficulty_org",
                  victimisation       = "rejection/bullying_org",
                  dist_friendship     = "dist_making_friends",
                  dist_withdrawal     = "dist_social_difficulty",
                  dist_victimisation  = "dist_rejection_bullying"))) %>%
  mutate(sex = factor(sex),
         referral = factor(referral),
         age_years = age_in_months / 12)

# Checks: N should be 992
nrow(dat)
table(dat$sex, useNA = "always")
table(dat$referral, useNA = "always")
```

# Names, order and colours

```{r}
profiles <- c(dist_friendship    = "Friendship difficulties",
              dist_withdrawal    = "Social withdrawal",
              dist_victimisation = "Peer victimisation",
              dist_prosocial     = "Prosocial behaviour")

dims <- c(friendship    = "Friendship difficulties",
          withdrawal    = "Social withdrawal",
          victimisation = "Peer victimisation",
          prosocial     = "Prosocial behaviour")

colours <- c("Friendship difficulties" = "#8C82C9",
             "Social withdrawal"       = "#D79251",
             "Peer victimisation"      = "#D97591",
             "Prosocial behaviour"     = "#56A89C")

# Dashed line = no significant age effect (friendship difficulties, q = .09)
linetypes <- c("Friendship difficulties" = "dashed",
               "Social withdrawal"       = "solid",
               "Peer victimisation"      = "solid",
               "Prosocial behaviour"     = "solid")
```

# Age distribution

```{r}
summary(dat$age_years)

dat %>%
  mutate(age_band = cut(age_years, breaks = c(5, 8, 11, 14, 19), right = FALSE)) %>%
  count(age_band)
```

# Model functions

```{r}
fit_gam <- function(y) {
  gam(as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ s(age_years, bs = 'cr', k = 10) + sex + referral")),
      data = dat, method = "REML")
}

# Age effect, FDR-corrected p, and deviance explained by age
# (full model minus the model without age)
age_table <- function(models, labels) {
  imap_dfr(models, function(m, y) {
    m0 <- gam(as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ sex + referral")), data = dat, method = "REML")
    st <- summary(m)$s.table
    tibble(Outcome = labels[[y]],
           N = nobs(m),
           edf = st[1, "edf"],
           F = st[1, "F"],
           p = st[1, "p-value"],
           `Deviance explained by age (%)` = (summary(m)$dev.expl - summary(m0)$dev.expl) * 100)
  }) %>%
    mutate(p_FDR = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"),
           across(c(edf, F, `Deviance explained by age (%)`), ~ round(.x, 2)),
           across(c(p, p_FDR), ~ signif(.x, 3)))
}

# Predicted values across age, for the most common sex and referral group
mode_level <- function(x) names(which.max(table(x)))

grid <- tibble(
  age_years = seq(min(dat$age_years, na.rm = TRUE), max(dat$age_years, na.rm = TRUE),
                  length.out = 200),
  sex = factor(mode_level(dat$sex), levels = levels(dat$sex)),
  referral = factor(mode_level(dat$referral), levels = levels(dat$referral))
)

predict_age <- function(models, labels) {
  imap_dfr(models, function(m, y) {
    p <- predict(m, newdata = grid, se.fit = TRUE)
    grid %>% mutate(fit = p$fit,
                    lower = p$fit - 1.96 * p$se.fit,
                    upper = p$fit + 1.96 * p$se.fit,
                    Outcome = labels[[y]])
  }) %>%
    mutate(Outcome = factor(Outcome, levels = labels))
}

raw_long <- function(labels) {
  dat %>%
    select(age_years, all_of(names(labels))) %>%
    pivot_longer(-age_years, names_to = "var", values_to = "score") %>%
    mutate(Outcome = factor(labels[var], levels = labels))
}

cat("Predictions shown for sex =", mode_level(dat$sex),
    "and referral =", mode_level(dat$referral), "\n")
```

# Centroid-distance scores by age

Lower distance indicates greater proximity to the profile centroid, and therefore stronger expression of that profile.

```{r}
models_dist <- map(names(profiles), fit_gam) %>% set_names(names(profiles))

# Model checks: k-index close to 1 and residuals
walk(models_dist, ~ { gam.check(.x); cat("\n") })

age_stats_dist <- age_table(models_dist, profiles)
age_stats_dist
```

## Figure: predicted centroid distance by age

```{r, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5}
preds_dist <- predict_age(models_dist, profiles)

fig_dist <- ggplot(preds_dist, aes(x = age_years, y = fit,
                                   colour = Outcome, fill = Outcome, linetype = Outcome)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.3) +
  geom_rug(data = dat, aes(x = age_years), inherit.aes = FALSE, sides = "b", alpha = 0.2) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(5, 8, 11, 14, 18)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = colours) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colours) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = linetypes) +
  labs(x = "Age (years)",
       y = "Predicted distance to profile centroid\n(lower = stronger expression)",
       colour = "Profile", fill = "Profile", linetype = "Profile") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 14))

fig_dist
```

## Figure: one panel per profile, with raw data

```{r, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 7}
fig_dist_panels <- ggplot(preds_dist, aes(x = age_years, y = fit, colour = Outcome)) +
  geom_point(data = raw_long(profiles), aes(y = score), alpha = 0.15, size = 0.8,
             position = position_jitter(width = 0, height = 0.05, seed = 1)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = Outcome), alpha = 0.25, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = Outcome), linewidth = 1.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ Outcome, nrow = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = colours, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colours, guide = "none") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = linetypes, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(5, 8, 11, 14, 18)) +
  labs(x = "Age (years)", y = "Distance to profile centroid\n(lower = closer)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 14),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

fig_dist_panels
```

# Supplement: social dimension scores by age

The same models fitted to the four social dimension scores (0-1; higher = more of that dimension).

```{r}
models_dim <- map(names(dims), fit_gam) %>% set_names(names(dims))

walk(models_dim, ~ { gam.check(.x); cat("\n") })

age_stats_dim <- age_table(models_dim, dims)
age_stats_dim
```

```{r, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 7}
preds_dim <- predict_age(models_dim, dims)

fig_dim_panels <- ggplot(preds_dim, aes(x = age_years, y = fit, colour = Outcome)) +
  geom_point(data = raw_long(dims), aes(y = score), alpha = 0.15, size = 0.8,
             position = position_jitter(width = 0, height = 0.015, seed = 1)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = Outcome), alpha = 0.25, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ Outcome, nrow = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = colours, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colours, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(5, 8, 11, 14, 18)) +
  labs(x = "Age (years)", y = "Dimension score") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 14),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

fig_dim_panels
```
